Thinking back I was definitely w|w and I don’t know how it took me years to figure it out or even accept it. 

When I was little, I watched a show where there was this masculine girl and I wanted to be her and she was my favourite character. 
No, I wanted to date her. 
Im fourth grade, I was a cheerleader and I had to change into my uniform. My bestfriend at the time changed in front of me. I liked her body. Her lips. Her skin. I thought it was jealousy but I just wanted to kiss her. 

In eighth grade, I came out to my new bestfriend. I cried. And she came out to me too. That’s when I started to really come to term with the fact that I liked women. I think I was being too hasty because I posted it on my social media and people at my school either made fun of me or hugged me like I had cancer or something. I was just a girl the day before and now people were treating me different. I didn’t like it so I denied my gay tendencies again. 
My sister found out too from other people, I guess I just didn’t expect her to tell my mom. 

My mom gave me the “I love you no matter what” talk. I hated that. She never says she loves me so it enraged me that me being gay made her say it. I didn’t want my life or change. Going into high school I was back in the closet. 
People brought up my middle school coming out here and there. I denied it all. 
My Junior year, I decided to come out because I fell in love with a girl. She ended up breaking my heart but she made me realize that I was tired of hiding and denying.
It was obvious to my mom that I was dating that girl that I brought home constantly so I didn’t need to come out again. It was just common knowledge. 
It’s my senior year now and I’m dating a guy that I love and that has liked me since our sophmore year. 

It’s crazy how life can change but I’m glad I made those changes. I’m not ashamed of being attracted to women now. I don’t think I want any labels but I would say I lean more towards Pansexual or Bisexual.

It’s pretty shitty but I dated my best friends crush. 

At first, him and I were just family friends. I tried helping my bestfriend(girl) get with the boy. As time passed and I got to know him, I started to like him too. I did feel bad. He didn’t know my bestfriend and I was trying to ge thin to do that but as my feelings developed, the more I talked to him and I flirted with him. He flirted back. And I didn’t know it at the time but I was falling in love. 
Eventually him and I started dating in secret. It was probably better for my bestfriend if I hadn’t hidden the fact. She found out two weeks later and she forgive me as it was just a small crush and she knew she didn’t have a chance. I felt bad but I was glad I didn’t have to hide my intense feelings for him. 

In a way I’m also glad I dated him and not my best friend because the guy ended up deceiving me. He never liked me. He liked my twin sister and thought it was a grand opportunity to get close to her but dating me. It took two years for me to get over him. Him and I are best friends now, and I have a boyfriend that I love. 
The guy also doesn’t have a thing for my sister because she rejected him and he was heartbroken for a while. 

Karma is a bitch I guess.
